rows.note: Use this for the act of recalling or a remembered event or experience; it is the all-purpose choice for these senses.

example.english: Whenever I think of that recollection, I can't help laughing.
example.traditional: 一講起嗰段回憶，我就忍唔住笑。
example.jyutping: jat1 gong2 hei2 go2 dyun6 wui4 jik1 ngo5 zau6 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3

rows.note: Use this for memory as stored mental content or the span of what someone can remember, rather than for a specific reminiscence.

example.english: That period is already starting to fade from my recollection.
example.traditional: 嗰段日子喺我嘅記憶入面已經開始模糊喇。
example.jyutping: go2 dyun6 jat6 zi2 hai2 ngo5 ge3 gei3 jik1 jap6 min6 ji5 ging1 hoi1 ci2 mou4 wu4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when sense 1 specifically means the ability or power to remember.

example.english: As I get older, my recollection has gotten much worse.
example.traditional: 我年紀大咗，記憶力差咗好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 nin4 gei2 daai6 zo2 gei3 jik1 lik6 caa1 zo2 hou2 do1
